newsitem.title: USA: Canandaigua stock falls on profit outlook.
newsitem.headline: Canandaigua stock falls on profit outlook.

text.p: The stock of Canandaigua Wine Co. Inc. plunged to a 12-month low Friday, a day after the nation's second-largest supplier of wines cut profit estimates for fiscal 1997.

The stock of Canandaigua, whose table wines include Almaden, Inglenook, Paul Masson, Taylor California Cellars and Manischewitz, fell $5.25 or more than 23 percent to $16.75 on Nasdaq in early afternoon trading.
Late Thursday, the Canandaigua, N.Y.-based company slashed profit estimates for the year ending Feb. 28, 1997 to a range of $1.10-$1.40 per share from $2.30-$2.50 previously.
Canandaigua had earnings of $1.92 per share, exclusive of one-time items, the previous year. It had profits of $8.5 million, or 43 cents a share, for the quarter ended May 31.

The nation's third-largest importer of beers and fourth-largest supplier of distilled spirits said it revised its profit estimate because of the surprisingly weak performance of its wine division, which offset better than expected results at its beer and spirits division, Barton.
Canandaigua sought to calm jittery investors in a conference call Friday, saying "problems are being addressed and corrected by management".
Canandaigua said internal operating inefficiencies, high grape prices, and a general slowing of growth in the wine industry also hurt its performance.

To remedy the internal inefficiencies, the company said it was implementing new management information systems, installing new leadership at its Mission Bell facility, and new financial management within the wine division.

But Canandaigua declined to discuss specifics. "We are preparing to announce our changes ... to our internal organisation shortly and until then, we are not in a position to discuss the details with the financial community," it said.
The company said it expects some one-time costs from the changes but not any significant restructuring charge.

Canandaigua imports Corona, St. Pauli Girl, Modelo Especial and Tsingtao beers. Its distilled spirits include Fleischmann's, Barton, Mr. Boston, Canadian LTD, Ten High Bourbon, Montezuma Tequila, Inver House Scotch and Monte Alban Mezcal.
